jobs.title: Practice Lead, Finance and Investment (Build and Scale a New Practice)
jobs.reason: This is a senior "Practice Lead" role requiring extensive experience building and scaling a finance/investment practice — well beyond the candidate's MSc-stage profile. Field (finance/investment advisory) is also outside the candidate's IR/policy and intelligence targets. Hard ineligibility on seniority.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff, Global Partnerships
jobs.reason: This is a senior GTM/commercial Chief of Staff role requiring 7+ years of experience including prior Chief of Staff or management consulting tenure supporting C-suite leaders — a hard ineligibility on seniority. The field (cloud/AI commercial partnerships) is also outside the candidate's policy/research target zones, and the role requires specific knowledge of hyperscaler/SI/ISV ecosystems the candidate lacks.

jobs.title: Migrant Futures Institute Events & Communications Coordinator
jobs.reason: Migration research and policy at a university institute is adjacent to the candidate's interests in post-atrocity politics, displacement, and critical IR, though this is an events/communications coordinator role rather than a research post. The candidate has relevant administrative and stakeholder-coordination experience from the German Rectors Conference, but lacks dedicated events/comms experience. Seniority and pay band fit a junior coordinator role reasonably well.

jobs.title: Coordinator
jobs.reason: This is an administrative/operations coordination role focused on scheduling, invoicing, and vendor management in Southeast Asia — unrelated to IR, policy research, intelligence, or OSINT. While the ESG context is mildly policy-adjacent, the actual work is logistical client-service coordination with no research component.
